comment: Runs for pkgtris.py (measured triangles from exported packages). Cells come from cells.json (1000 m x 1000 m around the stored centre, fetched with worldbake init-area + fetch); lakeview-sheil-park is a copy of the committed P2 test area. Profiles: null = the generator's own pick (regions.json: Chicago has no region, so `default`; there is no downtown profile in the engine); chicago-dense-north for the residential cells, as P2's BuildingLab and BuildingAreaTests use it for Lakeview; `default` runs of the residential cells repeat the pre-P2 baseline's profile for a like-for-like comparison. Focus `worldlab`: 470 m x 599 m centred, which selects the central 3 x 3 chunks, as the pre-P2 audit's WorldLab-sized focus (0.5 m short of the chunk lines at +-300 m).
